limits: The six saved binary64 q vectors are unchanged first-order poses, not equilibria of the hypothetical distributed normal law. No new force case, frame solve, native solve, CAD rebuild or design change is performed.

Use a real-arithmetic piecewise quadratic continuation of recorded linear nodal translations/rotations plus eccentric rigid arms, with actual own fitting ports, source contact directors and 1000 rotation storage scale. Preserve all beam-station cuts and endpoint clamping.

The existing nominal polygon-minus-two-full-holes domain and density are inherited. Local xy area is the declared nominal model measure; projection/rounding diagnostics do not certify CAD, actual geometry, material properties or physical contact.

Compare all 2112 original centroid gaps with their own stored sparse Bq and forces. Map/force gates1e-9mm/1e-7N are numerical intake controls. The1e-8mm opening/closure reporting gates are not resistance or physical acceptance criteria.

Exact Bernstein bounds enclose each polynomial on the bounding rectangle of each station-clipped polygon. Ignoring holes in outer area only enlarges force, moment and energy uppers. Inner witness boxes must lie strictly in one actual nominal material piece and outside both holes.

A floating grid only selects a candidate inner box; exact containment, circle-clearance and Bernstein inequalities decide every positive-area lower. Missing inner witnesses are inconclusive, never absence-of-contact or resistance passes.

The normal force/moment/energy intervals are at saved poses of a changed local law, not original saved forces, physical demand bounds, or new whole-frame equilibrium. The source wood/fitting operators remain gross analogies and the foundation prior remains unmeasured.
